prose: A twenty-six-hundred-ton walking dragline stranded in the center of Open Pit Coal Mine 4. The colossal machine stands eight stories tall in the drifting winter ash; its 94-meter tubular boom points toward the overcast sky like a rusted astronomical spire.

The 64mm main boom pendant cable snapped under explosive shockwave loading, whipping through the glass operator's cab like a steel scythe. The entire lattice boom collapsed across the pit wall, crushing the main swing gearbox beneath twelve hundred tons of twisted pipe.

The excavator's sixty-cubic-meter manganese steel bucket sits inverted upon a limestone ledge, roofed with railway ties and coal bags to form a bombproof five-man observation bunker. Rifle firing slits were cut through the 80mm lip plate with an oxy-gas torch.

Scavenger guilds spent eight months inside the machine house chiseling away the heavy armatures of the Ward-Leonard motor-generator sets. Eight tons of pure insulated copper windings were removed to wind new alternators for shelter power turbines.

The fifty-ton port walking shoe was halted midway through its thirty-foot stride when power dropped on Strike Day. The eccentric cam welded to its bronze bushing from lack of lube, leaving the entire machine tilted at an alarming eighteen-degree list.

A seismic ground shock cracked the twelve-meter-diameter cast-steel swing circle in three places. Sixty 200mm tapered alloy steel rollers spilled from the cage, jamming the upper revolving frame into an immovable monument facing the prevailing radioactive wind.

The 12-cylinder V-type auxiliary starting diesel is welded solid with salt-encrusted aluminum oxide. Acid rain entering the un-flapped exhaust manifold filled six cylinders with corrosive green sulfuric sludge, bending the connecting rods.

The hollow 350-ton steel counterweight box in the tail section filled with radioactive volcanic fallout slurry washed down from the machine roof. The box now acts as a high-intensity gamma emitter (12.5 R/hr at twenty paces), creating a deadly perimeter barrier around the cab.
